mapper.select: SELECT id,order_no,buyer_id,vendor_id,trip_id,status,buyer_deposit,vendor_deposit,buyer_deposit_status,vendor_deposit_status,goods_amount,address,purchase_receipt_urls,procurement_city,tax_refund_plan,tax_refund_amount,tax_rate FROM t_orders WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,owner_id,destination,origin_city,trip_type,return_date,boarding_at,depart_datetime,verify_status FROM t_trips WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,created_at FROM t_face_verifications WHERE user_id=#{actor} AND order_id=#{orderId} AND scene=#{scene} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id,created_at FROM t_face_verifications WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{actor} AND order_id=#{orderId} AND scene='delivery_confirm' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_orders SET status='purchased',purchase_evidence=CAST(#{evidence} AS JSON),purchase_meta=CAST(#{meta} AS JSON),purchase_receipt_urls=CAST(#{images} AS JSON),procurement_lat=#{lat},procurement_lng=#{lng},procurement_city=#{city},procurement_address=#{addr},procurement_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),purchase_face_verification_id=#{face},purchase_risk_flags=CAST(#{flags} AS JSON),tax_refund_amount=CASE WHEN tax_refund_plan='refund_to_buyer' THEN #{tax} ELSE tax_refund_amount END,location_mismatch=#{mismatch},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='locked'

UPDATE t_orders SET status='shipped',carrier_code=#{carrier},tracking_no=#{tracking},freight_label_urls=CAST(#{labels} AS JSON),ship_lat=#{lat},ship_lng=#{lng},ship_city=#{city},ship_address=#{addr},ship_risk_flags=CAST(#{flags} AS JSON),shipped_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),auto_confirm_at=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 10 DAY),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='purchased'

UPDATE t_trips SET boarding_snapshot_url=#{url},boarding_lat=NULLIF(#{lat},0),boarding_lng=NULLIF(#{lng},0),boarding_city=#{city},boarding_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),boarding_risk_flags=CAST(#{flags} AS JSON),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_id IS NOT NULL

UPDATE t_orders SET delivery_face_verification_id=#{face},delivery_lat=#{lat},delivery_lng=#{lng},delivery_city=#{city},delivery_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='shipped'

UPDATE t_orders SET status='cancelled_no_fault',closed_reason='no_boarding_proof',buyer_deposit_status=CASE WHEN buyer_deposit_status='frozen' THEN 'refunded' ELSE buyer_deposit_status END,vendor_deposit_status=CASE WHEN vendor_deposit_status='frozen' THEN 'refunded' ELSE vendor_deposit_status END,cancel_reason_type='carrier_no_boarding',cancel_penalty_amount=0,settled_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('requesting','negotiating','vendor_deposit_pending','locked')
UPDATE t_deposits SET status='refunded',reason='no_boarding_proof',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE order_id=#{id} AND status='frozen'
